column1: # MDK completion ledger -- the definition of "done" that the loop is checked against.
# Columns (tab-separated, exactly 7): id, level, speed, status, acceptance, evidence, verified
# level    d1 = the owner's goal (CONTINUATION.md:871): a build that plays a level
#          d2 = spec-complete on this host: everything in SPEC.md's P5-P8 and
#               SPEC-COMPLETION.md's remaining items that needs no console.
#          d3 = everything, including the closed-lid autonomous hardware cycle
#          Levels are cumulative: d2 requires the d1 rows too.
# speed    fast = runs in the per-iteration check; slow = runs at milestone boundaries.
# done     requires evidence that exists in the tree AND a verified commit that is
#          an ancestor of HEAD. A row is not done because a batch says so.
# owner-   requires a matching row in docs/OWNER_BLOCKS.md. A row cannot block itself.
# core.formats was broken for 25 batches (undefined reference to
# `mdk::scripts::forgetPoseCaches()`, unnoticed because check.sh never ran this
# target). Batches 130-132 fixed it and pinned the failure modes; re-verified
# p5.vulkan-goldens re-scoped 2026-11-14: the registered command lacked the
# script's mandatory <out.bmp> argument and exited 1 on usage without capturing
# anything. The acceptance now captures the pinned C# oracle frame and runs the
# frame gate against it (determinism, byte-exact baseline, fidelity ceiling) --
# strictly stronger, not weaker. Requires a .NET 10 SDK (MDK_DOTNET).
# p6 sub-batches (owner itemization 2026-11-14; the row closes only when
# ALL are done -- no sub-step is separately closable): (a) lighting rig
# DONE at ccbf13a (bit-exact in tests/formats); (b) colour textures;
# (c) lit pipeline; (d) sun shadow; (e) depth/occlusion/post; (f) filtered
# canvas + enhanced sky; (g) mods/HD textures. Landed already: flat stereo
# (8b82a1b, oracle gap 4.833% under a 6.0 ceiling) and the gamma grade
# enhanced on PICA200 hardware paths (combiners, ProcTex, lighting LUTs),
# ETC1/ETC1A4 .t3x packs baked with tex3ds for HD textures (the
# ../forsaken method); original look keeps lossless RGBA8.
# mdk_render_set_enhanced_toggles live seam, and the in-game
# Video/Graphics menu (SELECT over the paused game, FTI fonts) are
# implemented; every 3DS enhanced feature lands behind its toggle
